status: Analytic theorem bounds and arithmetic only; no simulated or observed device.
dimension_convention: Quantum dimension is counted within each classical branch; arbitrary classical records are permitted.
input_for_mean_bound: Maximally mixed payload, equivalently the input marginal of a Bell-pair experiment.

parameters.emission_error_scope: Exact declared emission for these numbers. Under the same fixed timing, an imperfect emission needs r evaluated at epsilon+nu and the additional ell*nu correction to actual expected prefix memory; see ../proofs/emission_error_refinement.txt.

memory_counts.capacity_warning: Whole-qubit capacity is a maximum over classical branches. The expected-memory bound is a separate average and is not asserted branchwise.
memory_counts.early_receiver: Constant coherent buffering plus O(log n) classical seed/controller state; exact meter and protection overhead are not assigned a number here.

retained_qubit_time.unit: qubit*arrival_interval; multiply the no-header number by tau in seconds for qubit-seconds
retained_qubit_time.header_latency_definition: t_hdr is time after the flag before ANY selector information is available to the quantum receiver. The unconditioned bound cannot automatically be extended through a progressively revealed header.

optional_serial_header_example.assumption: A separate classical link buffer assembles 25 metadata bits at one bit per arrival interval and withholds ALL selector information from the quantum receiver until atomic disclosure. This extra interface assumption is not part of the base plotted bound. Progressive disclosure does not justify this number without a conditional bound.

retained_qubit_time.scope: Expected logical receiver occupancy under the specified input marginal, before physical protection overhead. This lower bound does not assert an achievable fractional-memory strategy.

abstract_online_resource_bounds.classical_program_work: O(n*k^2) elementary bit operations with schoolbook field multiplication
abstract_online_resource_bounds.excluded_from_abstract_counts: hardware gate decomposition, meter reset/preparation, calibration, correlated factory errors, routing constants and protection overhead

figure.early_buffer_warning: Line drawn at 1 solely to illustrate O(1) scaling; it is not an exact meter/apparatus count and is not used in the resource calculation.
